readiness_rule: every interim placement has review date, exit class, owner, and unresolved-need fallback
immediate enrollment or school-origin/best-interest decision cannot wait for ordinary paperwork
shelter/relocation exit requires medication, device, dialysis/oxygen, record, and referral check
commodity, benefit, retailer, meal, formula, special-diet, and transport path must be checked for next cycle
safe return requires essential service connection or explicit safe degraded mode
aid/tax/court/benefit/insurance/utility/appeal clocks require disaster hold or reopen path
case ledger tracks accepted referrals, benefit stack, duplication decision, unresolved need, closure/reopen
